name: @mcowger/pi-llmgateway
description: A Pi extension that adds [LLM Gateway](https://llmgateway.io) as a model provider, giving you access to 160+ chat models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, Mistral, DeepSeek, and many others through a single OpenAI-compatible API.
